metadata.description: Faction-vs-faction conflict outcome line sets for staged escalation.

aggressor: UFP patrol has positive ID on Blister signature. Maintain vector and report intent.
Blister hull flagged on patrol scope. We are watching your burn profile.
response: Copy your signal, patrol. Keep your watch and we'll keep our lane.
You see us. Good. Try not to confuse seeing with controlling.

aggressor: Blister vessel, reduce profile and declare cargo now.
You're crossing too close to controlled traffic. Explain your route.
response: Our cargo is none of your parade business.
You can ask questions all day. Answers are extra.

aggressor: Course correction ordered. Drift to inspection vector immediately.
Patrol authority invoked. Cut thrust and prepare boarding posture.
response: Negative on boarding posture. We are not surrendering schedule.
Inspection vector denied. You'll have to chase.

aggressor: Warning shots away. Next spread lands center mass.
Weapons free on engines only. Disable and contain.
response: Contact! Returning fire and breaking hard.
You opened the dance. We're not standing still.

aggressor: Target disengaging. Hold perimeter and log incident.
Interception complete. Traffic lane secure for now.
response: We're clear of your box. This isn't finished.
Breaking contact. Keep your medals; we'll keep flying.

aggressor: Arcworks control tags Blister transponder near regulated assets.
Unknown raider profile near Arcworks corridor. Signal acknowledged.
response: You don't own the vacuum, supervisor.
We are passing through. Try not to panic publicly.

aggressor: Blister craft, this corridor is under industrial security jurisdiction.
Declare intent near Condenser Columns or exit the lane.
response: Our intent is profit. Your jurisdiction is a bedtime story.
We'll leave when leaving is efficient, not when told.

aggressor: Security tugs moving to pin your vector. Stand by for scan.
Arcworks inspection hold initiated. Cancel burn now.
response: Inspection hold refused. We are maneuvering free.
Pin this vector if you can catch it.

aggressor: Engine block engaged. Arcworks batteries firing containment pattern.
You ignored lawful hold. Weapons release authorized.
response: Containment my hull—returning fire.
Arcworks shots on us. Breaking and punching back.

aggressor: Contact dispersed. Resume industrial traffic protocol.
Hostile profile pushed off asset ring. Log damage and reset watch.
response: We're off your metal pile. Count that as mercy.
Disengaging. We'll invoice you later in another lane.

aggressor: Civilian freighter marked. Keep your channel open and your speed honest.
Slow boat on our scope. Don't do anything heroic.
response: We're civilian freight on contract schedule. Passing through.
Acknowledged. We are not looking for trouble.

aggressor: Dump your manifest to channel. Now.
Who paid you to move that cargo? Answer carefully.
response: Manifest is sealed to client and insurer.
We carry food and meds, not politics.

aggressor: Civilian, cut thrust and drift for inspection.
You are being boarded for contribution review.
response: Unable to comply safely—request neutral corridor escort.
This is a civilian distress declaration.

aggressor: Shots across bow. Next burst takes your drives.
Disable fire pattern live. Don't make us waste ammo.
response: Mayday! Taking fire, engines hit.
Distress, distress—civilian vessel under raid attack.

aggressor: Collection complete. Move along if you can still move.
Raid window closed. Break contact.
response: We're limping out. Requesting aid at nearest station.
Disengaging under protest and emergency claim.

aggressor: Civilian contact, this is UFP patrol requesting routine identity ping.
Freighter profile detected near patrol zone. Maintain lane and report flag.
response: Identity ping sent. Civilian registry and insurance attached.
Copy patrol. We are on a contracted delivery run.

aggressor: Your route overlaps restricted traffic. State cargo class.
We have supply-diversion indicators. Clarify destination.
response: Cargo class is humanitarian dry goods.
Destination is lawful port; we can provide paperwork.

aggressor: Civilian vessel, shift to inspection hold for scan verification.
Patrol intercept initiated. Reduce burn and stand by.
response: Complying with hold; requesting delay waiver filing.
Under protest, we are reducing burn for inspection.

aggressor: Non-compliance escalated. Warning fire authorized.
Disable profile only—do not core the hull.
response: We are civilian and unarmed! Cease fire!
Taking warning impacts—drives unstable.

aggressor: Inspection concluded. Civilian released with caution flag.
Contact cleared to depart. Incident logged.
response: Resuming route with loss claim pending.
Departure acknowledged. Filing complaint through station authority.

aggressor: Arcworks control requesting civilian transponder handshake.
Civilian contact near industrial lane, identify cargo safety class.
response: Handshake sent; cargo is stable and declared.
We are civilian transit with no hazardous intent.

aggressor: Your docking priority is suspended pending Arcworks review.
We suspect embargo leakage through this lane. Explain manifest.
response: Suspending us jeopardizes perishables and contract terms.
Manifest is legal commercial cargo under station seal.

aggressor: Industrial security intercept in progress. Hold position.
You are ordered to submit for close scan at Onion Skin control.
response: Holding under protest. This delay is billable.
Complying with scan. Recording all channels for arbitration.

aggressor: Warning burst issued for safety compliance failure.
Arcworks defense firing non-lethal disable pattern.
response: Civilian distress! We are taking rounds from Arcworks control.
Drive section hit—request emergency tugs.

aggressor: Review complete. Civilian traffic may resume under flag.
Interception closed. Return to standard approach queue.
response: Resuming queue, with this delay noted for claims.
Understood. Continuing route at reduced confidence.

aggressor: Unknown Blister tag on local channel. State crew mark.
Dragoon contact, your transponder smells wrong.
response: Crew mark is valid. Keep your paranoia in check.
Tag is ours. Your scope is twitchy today.

aggressor: You're cutting into our collection lane.
Back off the bounty trail before this gets expensive.
response: Lane isn't yours unless you can hold it.
If you wanted exclusivity you should've flown faster.

aggressor: Cut thrust and settle this share split now.
Intercepting. You owe us a percentage and patience.
response: Not paying. Catch us if you're serious.
Share split denied. Take your grievance to vacuum court.

aggressor: Fine. We settle this with burn marks.
Weapons hot. Keep your nose if you can.
response: Friendly fire my hull—returning in kind.
You picked the dumb option. Firing back.

aggressor: Enough. We're done bleeding margins here.
Break contact. Next dispute gets settled in person.
response: Copy break. Keep your lane and your temper.
Disengaging. This debt isn't forgotten.
